title: Clothing sizes – Kaderblick documentation

hero.heading: Clothing sizes
hero.lead: This area summarises the equipment sizes of a team’s players, coaches and supporters. Coaches can identify missing details, remind individual members and create an order summary.

body:
Select a team and read the table

  1. Select the team at the top. The number in the selector is the total number of included members.
  2. The team header separates the player, coach and supporter counts.
  3. The table groups people by function and shows shorts, shirt, jacket, shoe and socks sizes. A dash means that no size has been entered.
  4. Under Size distribution, each item type shows the quantity per size and the number of members without a value.

Request missing details

  1. The number on Send reminder is the count of members missing at least one of the five values. The button is disabled when all details are complete.
  2. Open the dialogue. Each person’s missing values are listed directly below their name.
  3. Clear the tick beside anyone who should not receive a notification.
  4. If required, enable Create task in calendar. A task due date then appears.
  5. The final button shows the number of selected recipients. Select it to send the reminders.

Prepare an order

  1. Select Create order.
  2. For each person, select the required items. Items without a recorded size are labelled Size missing and cannot be selected.
  3. Use Everything for the team, Shirts only, Shorts only, Jackets only, Socks only or Shoes only for a quick selection. Clear selection resets it.
  4. The summary at the bottom shows the item count and the number of people concerned.
  5. Select Create order PDF. Kaderblick generates the order list and opens it in a new browser tab.

Where members maintain their sizes

Players, coaches and supporters enter their own details under My profile. The team overview uses the shorts, shirt, training jacket, shoe and socks sizes from those profile details.

Access and related areas

  • Coaches: in the verified demo, they see the members of their team and can create reminders and order PDFs.
  • A task created in the reminder dialogue appears in the selected members’ calendar.
  • Supporters are included in the team count and their own group when assigned to the team.
